meta.what: Pixel measurements of the layout reference ad (third-party creator video, kept outside the repo). Only geometry, colours and timing of the template were measured; no footage or logos are stored.
meta.units: all numbers are reference pixels at 720x1280. The reference was evidently designed at 1080x1920 and downscaled by 2/3 (card y=336/1070, h=594, margin 12, radius 24 at 1080 give exactly the numbers below), so --scale 1.5 reproduces the original 1080x1920 grid.
meta.method: numpy on full-res decoded frames: temporal median image for static elements, edge/profile scans for boxes and corner radius, integrated line-profile deficiency for wave colours, per-frame bar-end tracking for progress, per-frame intro crops for animation timing, IoU font search for the typeface.

background.note: cream / off-white with a very slight vertical+horizontal drift; measured on wave-free, shadow-free pixels

top.measured: left edge x=8.0, right edge x=712.0, top edge y=224.0 (sharp), bottom edge y=620.0; corner radius fit 16 (+-1) from corner coverage

bottom.measured: top edge y=713.35, bottom edge y=1109.5 (design grid y=1070 at 1080 scale); vertical gap between cards 93.3 px

shadow.measured: darkening below the bottom edge ~25 levels (216 vs 240), at the sides ~14, above the top edge ~6 -> soft shadow offset ~9 px downward, sigma ~11 px

logo.glyph: white starburst, ~47 px diameter (reference: 12 organic petals; ours: clean 8-ray burst, own drawing)
logo.measured: box x=329.5..391.5 (+-1), y=72..136, flat colour (215,118,86); centred horizontally on 360

text.font: Hanken Grotesk Bold (OFL; chosen as best IoU match 0.81 of 13 candidate families against the reference glyph mask; no Inter match: reference is narrower with lower x-height ratio)
text.measured: cap height 33 px, text width 170 px, colour (26,32,28), semi-bold

badge.note: dark translucent pill (backdrop blurred) with 1.5 px light outline, icon + white semi-bold label
badge.measured_bottom_pill: outer x=20.5..291.8 (w~271) for 'Mira AI x After Effects'; y = card top + 12, h 40

progress.geometry: last 4 px of each card (y=616..619 top card, 1105.3..1109.3 bottom card), clipped by the card's rounded corners; fill grows linearly from the card's left edge
progress.behaviour: fill end x = 8 + 704 * t / 14.96 (fits t=0.5 -> 32, 6.5 -> 314, 12 -> 574, 14.5 -> 694 within 3 px); both bars move in lock-step; reaches the right edge at the last frame
progress.measured: orange (228,129,25)-(233,134,30) over rows 616..619, unfilled track ~ (122,122,122) over card (67,67,67) = white at 29%

waves.note: thin wave lines behind the cards and header; geometry is animated slowly (curves morph over ~12 s). Keyframed model in wave_model.json (measured by measure_waves.py: worst per-frame mean error 1.8 px).
waves.measured: line colours from integrated line-profile deficiency (bg - sum of pixel drop / width); widths 1.8-2.4 px

intro_animation.note: all other elements (cards, badges, waves, background) are present from frame 0; progress bars start at 0

logo.effect: fade in 0->1, scale 0.88->1, rotation ~+12deg -> 0 (ease-out), slight blur that clears

intro_animation.word_effect: fade in 0->1 (starts light grey), rise ~22 px, blur ~7 px -> 0 (ease-out); words staggered by 0.25 s; header complete at ~1.1 s
